I can’t directly book or arrange an HVAC maintenance visit through this system, but I can help you get everything ready so it’s quick to set up with a local provider.

Here’s the fastest way to arrange annual HVAC maintenance:

1. Gather the basics:
   - System type (e.g., central AC + gas furnace, heat pump, mini‑split).
   - Brand/model if you can find the label on the indoor/outdoor unit.
   - Your address and preferred days/times (weekday vs weekend, morning vs afternoon).

2. Contact 2–3 local HVAC companies (search “HVAC maintenance [your city]”):
   - Ask for an “annual/seasonal HVAC tune‑up” or “preventive maintenance visit.”
   - Confirm what’s included (coil cleaning, filter check/replace, electrical checks, refrigerant check, thermostat check, etc.).
   - Ask for a flat price for maintenance and whether they offer a yearly maintenance plan.

3. When you book, mention:
   - Any issues you’ve noticed (odd noises, weak airflow, hot/cold spots, higher bills, smells).
   - Recent repairs (past year or so).
   - Access notes: pets, gate codes, parking, attic/crawlspace equipment, etc.

4. Timing:
   - Cooling-heavy areas: schedule in early spring.
   - Heating-heavy areas: schedule in early fall.
   - If you’re overdue, just schedule the next convenient date and repeat yearly.

If you tell me:
- What kind of system you have,
- Your city/region,
- Any current symptoms,

I can draft a short email/text or phone call script you can use to contact local HVAC companies, plus a brief checklist of questions to ask before you confirm an appointment.</action>

- Whether you offer any annual maintenance plans or memberships for ongoing service.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
